id.description:
Globally unique id for the lock (e.g. GUID).  It is the responsibility of the implementor of {@link InvalidationQueueStore.lock} to set this
appropriately.  Values for this should never be reused, even across multiple calls to the api.

entries.description: List of locked queue entries to dispatch for computing.

title:
Result returned from {@link InvalidationQueueStore.lock} that will be dispatched
for computing.
name: LockedEntries
